summary: Pakistani organizations should immediately prioritize patching critical vulnerabilities including CVE-2026-20349 and CVE-2026-68820, which are being actively exploited and listed in the CISA KEV catalog, affecting multiple vendors such as Microsoft and Google. The top zero-day exploits, including CVE-2026-72898 and CVE-2026-8037, also require urgent attention as they can be used to gain unauthorized access to systems, and Pakistani organizations should refer to the Pakistan CERT/NCCS alerts, specifically PKCERT-71DA9F40 and PKCERT-E48A22A6, for guidance on mitigation. To minimize the risk of compromise, Pakistani organizations should focus on implementing patches and mitigations for these critical vulnerabilities, particularly those affecting widely used software from vendors like Adobe and Cisco, as highlighted in the Pakistan CERT/NCCS alerts PKCERT-0E16B8D5 and PKCERT-E6090A61.
